revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: 20261124 render shutdown admission: Manager.stop publishes its stable promise, marks the manager stopped and synchronously closes all owned endpoint admission before asynchronous transport shutdown. Late render-event frames are released through the existing closed-port path and old D3D9 layers become stale immediately; delayed frames cannot overwrite a replacement publication. Ports remain owned until the existing finalizer rejects requests, notifies error subscribers, clears maps/credits and awaits physical termination. No early heap retirement, new guest callback, context restoration, invocation or native completion authority. Frozen full-production Manager/host-imports/GPU presenter/renderer deterministic regression fails nine of 27 baseline checks and passes all 27 after the minimal fix, including replacement pixels, repaint/publication counts, foreign renderer updates, idempotent stop and independently held acknowledgement/physical termination. Existing renderer boundary, worker lifecycle, manager callback cleanup and display failure suites pass. Broader invocation ownership remains pending.
